messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday) and is flanked by a Saturday and a Sunday, giving you three consecutive days off.

| Date(s) | Holiday | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|---------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | New Year’s Day | Observed Jan 2 (Monday) | Jan 1 (Sun) – Jan 2 (Mon) |
| **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | — | Feb 18 (Sat) – Feb 20 (Mon) |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday | — | Apr 7 (Fri) – Apr 9 (Sun) |
| **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day | — | May 20 (Sat) – May 22 (Mon) |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day | Observed Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1 (Sat) – Jul 3 (Mon) |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day | — | Sep 2 (Sat) – Sep 4 (Mon) |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | — | Oct 7 (Sat) – Oct 9 (Mon) |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day | Observed Nov 13 (Mon) | Nov 11 (Sat) – Nov 13 (Mon) |
| **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas | — | Dec 23 (Sat) – Dec 25 (Mon) |

### Quick Notes

* **New Year’s Day** fell on a Sunday, so the official observance was on Monday Jan 2.  
* **Canada Day** fell on a Saturday; the observance was on Monday Jul 3.  
* **Remembrance Day** fell on a Saturday; the observance was on Monday Nov 13.  
* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) was a Tuesday, so it did *not* create a long weekend.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, or the extra holidays in Quebec), let me know and I can add those too.
